name: Quantum Computing Systems Programmer
description: Develop classical control software for quantum computers. Implement qubit control pulses, error correction, and quantum circuit compilers.
example_snippet:
program QuantumCircuit:
    shape Qubit holds:
        Alpha as fractional number
        Beta as fractional number
    end shape

    action apply_hadamard takes Q as ref Qubit produces nothing:
        keep NewAlpha as fractional number
        put the quotient of the sum of Q.Alpha and Q.Beta and 1.4142 into NewAlpha
        keep NewBeta as fractional number
        put the quotient of the difference of Q.Alpha and Q.Beta and 1.4142 into NewBeta
        put NewAlpha into Q.Alpha
        put NewBeta into Q.Beta
    end action

    keep Q1 as Qubit with 1.0 and 0.0
    call apply_hadamard with Q1
    print the text "Qubit after H gate: alpha=" and Q1.Alpha and " beta=" and Q1.Beta and newline
end program
status_note: C++ backend active (C++17/20/23, CI-tested). Quantum circuit serialization via dictum_json.c. Quantum hardware APIs require C imports.
